static_traits.name: Zhang Jingyi
static_traits.social_status: Has several close friends, but rarely takes the initiative to confide personal feelings of loneliness
static_traits.medical_history: Without significant physical illness; without previous psychotherapy history; without similar psychological problem experiences before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, coherent thinking, slightly anxious at first but willing to cooperate; able to recognize and discuss negative thinking under guidance; steady speech pace, high cooperation

basic_info.main_problem: Feeling trapped indoors in fall and winter (especially on weekends), lonely and isolated, unable to fully enjoy my favorite season as before; worsened in recent years with self-questioning about unmarried status and perceived social pressure, leading to going out less, social withdrawal, and decreased drive for self-care.
basic_info.core_demands: These feelings of loneliness and isolation in my favorite season have become hard to bear, affecting mood and daily activities; hoping to get help through counseling.
growth_experiences: A few years ago, gradually began experiencing feeling trapped indoors and loneliness in fall and winter, while developing self-questioning about being unmarried and feeling social expectations and pressure; since then, symptoms worsen every fall and winter (especially weekends), gradually developing into going out less, social withdrawal, and decreased drive for self-care.

core_beliefs: I am destined to be lonely
If I have not met society's marriage standards, I am not accepted

special_situations.event: Cold weekend weather in fall and winter, often staying indoors, associating that I am unable to enjoy the season as I did in the past
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If it is fall/winter or the weather is cold, I am unable to go out and enjoy; staying home equals wasting my favorite season
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Uses indoor activities and developing new hobbies to distract himself, but still goes out less
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will be stuck at home forever; autumn and winter will be wasted like this

special_situations.event: Noticing peers' and society's expectations about marriage, thinking that I am still not married
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am still not married at this age, it means I am not normal, not recognized
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-comparison, self-blame, avoiding socializing to avoid being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: At my age I should be married, otherwise it is failure

special_situations.event: Thinking about whether to confide feelings of loneliness to friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I express loneliness and needs, I will trouble my friends and affect the relationship
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Keeping silent, not actively seeking help or sharing feelings
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They do not want to be troubled by me, I should not say these things

special_situations.event: Comparing with the past self who could enjoy fall and winter, thinking about the present and future state
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If it is this difficult now, every fall and winter in the future will be like this, and change will be ineffective
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces attempts to change and go out, falls into negative comparison
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Things will not get better, I will stay like this every fall and winter

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be accepted and build intimate connections, and to go out freely in the beloved season, enjoying life
core_conflict.fear: Afraid of being rejected and judged as 'not normal / a failure', worried about being hurt after exposing vulnerability, and that loneliness will continue unchanged
defense_goal: Avoiding being rejected and negative evaluation by keeping distance and self-isolating
Internalizes social standards to gain a sense of security and direction
Repressing insecurity and vulnerability with rational analysis and self-demands

object_relations.self_representation: Seeing oneself as a lonely person who may trouble others
object_relations.object_representation: Friends / others are imagined as people unwilling to be burdened, who may not want to listen
Society/others are experienced as a collective carrying judgment and demands

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor explores whether he can share feelings with friends and build support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes expressing one's needs will burden others and the relationship may worsen
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Gentle and polite tone, emphasizing 'I do not want to trouble others', stating concerns more than directly requesting support.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When topics related to being unmarried and social expectations are discussed
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Unconsciously internalizing social norms and others' expectations as self-standards, judging oneself with 'should / must'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using 'should, must' and similar words for self-evaluation, restrained tone, with self-reproach, reducing emotional disclosure.

manifestations: Experiencing significant loneliness and feeling trapped in fall and winter (especially weekends)
Worsened with self-questioning about unmarried status and social pressure
Hesitates to express feelings to friends, worried about becoming a burden, and so seeks help less
Comparing with my past self who could enjoy the seasons, feeling a gap and isolation
outcomes: Decreased drive for self-care and daily activities

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Feeling strong social pressure due to being unmarried, evaluating oneself with 'should / must' standards
Equates society's expectations about marriage with the criterion of self-worth

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Not expressing loneliness and needs for fear of disturbing friends
Speaks cautiously in sessions and interpersonal settings, talking more about ideas rather than directly seeking support

positive_force: Work performance stable(occupational functioning remains good)
Has several close friends who can be contacted (potential social support)
Proactively seeks help and holds a positive attitude toward counseling, willing to practice cognitive restructuring
Able to recognize and describe negative automatic thoughts
Has tried self-help coping through indoor activities and new hobbies
negative_force: Strong loneliness and feeling trapped triggered by the fall/winter season
Introjecting marriage and social expectations, leading to self-reproach
Cognitive distortions such as predicting the future and mental filtering maintain the low mood
Avoiding asking friends for help, fearing being a burden
Decreased motivation and self-care decreasing, forming a vicious cycle

target_behavior.behavior: Stays indoors for long periods on autumn and winter weekends; goes out less
antecedent: Cold weather in autumn and winter
The automatic thought 'I will be trapped / wasting the season' appears
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing and negative anticipation of the cold season, accompanied by rising loneliness; internalized social pressure triggers low mood
target_behavior.function: Escaping uncomfortable emotions and possible social insecurity
target_behavior.consequence: Social isolation worsened, low mood, decreased appreciation of and satisfaction with the season

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding expressing loneliness to friends and seeking support
antecedent: Thinking about whether to contact friends when feeling lonely
target_behavior.core_reason: Worrying about troubling others, being rejected or judged
target_behavior.consequence: Reduced social support, loneliness maintained and worsened

target_behavior.behavior: Decreased motivation for self-care and daily activities
antecedent: When mood is low on autumn and winter weekends
Having the thought that 'things will not get better'
target_behavior.core_reason: Overgeneralization and emotional reasoning leading to helplessness and withdrawal
target_behavior.function: Briefly lowers effort to avoid feelings of failure and frustration
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased quality of life, negative emotions and avoidance behaviors forming a cycle
